context: Mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 大袈裟/串/コースター/灯り/偽物/同年代/重たい/ピーマン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、大袈裟、絶対、に、絶対、お話、絶対、するわよね
lines.en: Sho, your dad really does exaggerate everything, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warm observation, a little amused. Soft opening. Eyes crinkling slightly. The tone of someone who's noticed this about him a hundred times and finds it endearing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、串、絶対、団子、絶対、食べたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really seriously want to eat dango on a stick.
lines.style: Genuine eagerness. Bright, direct. No performance—just want landing clearly. Small insistence in the voice, the way a six-year-old states a fact that matters to him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、コースター、絶対、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's taste in coasters is really quite stylish, isn't it.
lines.style: Gentle approval. Slight lift on the compliment. Not over-praising—noticing something real. The warmth of someone commenting on a detail he'd be proud to hear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お部屋の、本気で、絶対、灯り、絶対、優しいね
lines.en: Mom, the light in our room is so gentle, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft wonder. Thoughtful pace. The voice of a child noticing something quietly beautiful and wanting to share it. No urgency—just observation offered up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、その、本気で、絶対、偽物、絶対、のおもちゃ、絶対、捨てましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we should probably throw away that toy—the broken one.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but kind. Not commanding. A gentle suggestion that this is the right thing to do. Practical tone, no edge. The efficiency of someone who knows how to guide a child without forcing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、同年代、絶対、のお友達、絶対、たくさんいるよ
lines.en: Mom, I really do have lots of friends my own age now.
lines.style: Pride threading through. Straightforward delivery. A small smile in the voice—he's telling her something he's been wanting to share. Genuine confidence, not boasting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、その、本気で、絶対、重たい、絶対、鞄、絶対、お母さん、絶対、持ってあげるわ
lines.en: Sho, that heavy bag looks like a lot—let Mom carry it for you.
lines.style: Tender offer. Steady, unhurried. The voice of someone who doesn't need to be asked twice and finds care in the small weight of things. Gentle insistence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、ピーマン、絶対、食べられるようになったよ
lines.en: Mom, I can actually eat green peppers now.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Understated but real. The satisfaction of a small, genuine win. Told without fanfare—just offering it up to her, knowing she'll understand what it means.
